Built from https://github.com/danilrwx/patchtree at tag @TAG@ (commit @SHA@).
The attached source archive is that tag, verbatim.

Rebuild (Node 22; network access is needed to fetch the pinned assets):

  make              # fetch pinned wasm/fonts/queries/themes, npm install, bundle into dist/
  make zip-firefox  # rewrite the manifest for Firefox and archive dist/

esbuild bundles src/ into dist/content.js and dist/background.js without
minification; assets/ is copied verbatim. The binary assets (tree-sitter wasm
grammars, highlight queries, fonts, theme data) are fetched from pinned upstream
releases by scripts/fetch-*.sh — they are not stored in the repository.

The extension talks only to the host serving the .diff page and that host's API
(GitLab/GitHub) to render diffs and post review actions. Access tokens are
entered by the user, kept in storage.local, and never sent anywhere else. No
analytics, no third-party servers — hence data_collection_permissions: none.
